fields.name: AV-2 VTOL – Hybrid ISR UAV
fields.description: AV-2 VTOL combines vertical take-off and landing with efficient fixed-wing flight. It is an ISR/ISTAR workhorse designed for long-endurance surveillance, target acquisition and support to strike assets. The airframe uses a lightweight composite structure for high durability and resistance to wind, while keeping logistics and deployment simple for frontline units.
fields.description_en: AV-2 VTOL combines vertical take-off and landing with efficient fixed-wing flight. It is an ISR/ISTAR workhorse designed for long-endurance surveillance, target acquisition and support to strike assets. The airframe uses a lightweight composite structure for high durability and resistance to wind, while keeping logistics and deployment simple for frontline units.
fields.description_de: AV-1 VTOL kombiniert vertikales Starten und Landen mit effizientem Starrflügelflug. Es handelt sich um ein ISR/ISTAR-Arbeitstier, das für die Langzeitüberwachung, Zielerfassung und Unterstützung bei Angriffsangriffen konzipiert ist. Die Flugzeugzelle verfügt über eine leichte Verbundstruktur für hohe Haltbarkeit und Windbeständigkeit, während Logistik und Einsatz für Fronteinheiten einfach bleiben.
fields.description_sk: AV-1 VTOL kombinuje vertikálny vzlet a pristátie s efektívnym letom s pevným krídlom. Je to ťažný kôň ISR/ISTAR navrhnutý pre dlhotrvajúci dohľad, získavanie cieľov a podporu úderných prostriedkov. Drak lietadla využíva ľahkú kompozitnú štruktúru pre vysokú trvanlivosť a odolnosť voči vetru, pričom je logistika a nasadenie pre jednotky v prvej línii jednoduché.
fields.description_es: AV-1 VTOL combina despegue vertical y aterrizaje con un eficiente vuelo fijo. Es un caballo de trabajo ISR/ISTAR diseñado para vigilancia de larga duración, adquisición de objetivos y soporte para activos de huelga. El airframe utiliza una estructura compuesta ligera para alta durabilidad y resistencia al viento, manteniendo la logística y el despliegue sencillos para las unidades de primera línea.
fields.description_fr: AV-1 VTOL combine décollage vertical et atterrissage avec un vol à voilure fixe efficace. Il s'agit d'un cheval de travail ISR/ISTAR conçu pour la surveillance de longue durée, l'acquisition de cibles et le soutien aux actifs de frappe. La cellule utilise une structure composite légère pour une grande durabilité et une grande résistance au vent, tout en gardant la logistique et le déploiement simples pour les unités de première ligne.
fields.description_it: AV-1 VTOL combina decollo verticale e atterraggio con un efficiente volo fisso. È un cavallo di lavoro ISR/ISTAR progettato per la sorveglianza di lunga durata, l'acquisizione e il supporto per colpire le attività. L'airframe utilizza una struttura composita leggera per un'elevata durata e resistenza al vento, mantenendo la logistica e l'implementazione semplici per le unità frontali.

fields.description: AXQ is a compact tactical quadcopter designed as a consumable asset for direct support of small units. It provides day/night ISR, precision delivery of small payloads and kinetic engagement of hostile UAVs. Despite its small size, AXQ offers meaningful range and payload capability, making it a flexible tool for infantry, special forces and security units
fields.description_en: AXQ is a compact tactical quadcopter designed as a consumable asset for direct support of small units. It provides day/night ISR, precision delivery of small payloads and kinetic engagement of hostile UAVs. Despite its small size, AXQ offers meaningful range and payload capability, making it a flexible tool for infantry, special forces and security units
fields.description_de: AXQ ist ein kompakter taktischer Quadcopter, der als Verbrauchsmaterial zur direkten Unterstützung kleiner Einheiten konzipiert ist. Es bietet Tag/Nacht-ISR, präzise Lieferung kleiner Nutzlasten und kinetischen Angriff feindlicher UAVs. Trotz seiner geringen Größe bietet AXQ eine bedeutende Reichweite und Nutzlastfähigkeit, was es zu einem flexiblen Werkzeug für Infanterie, Spezialeinheiten und Sicherheitseinheiten macht
fields.description_sk: AXQ je kompaktná taktická kvadrokoptéra navrhnutá ako spotrebný materiál pre priamu podporu malých jednotiek. Poskytuje denné/nočné ISR, presné dodanie malého užitočného zaťaženia a kinetické zapojenie nepriateľských UAV. Napriek svojej malej veľkosti ponúka AXQ zmysluplný rozsah a užitočné zaťaženie, čo z neho robí flexibilný nástroj pre pechotu, špeciálne sily a bezpečnostné jednotky.
fields.description_es: AXQ es un quadcopter táctico compacto diseñado como un activo consumible para el soporte directo de unidades pequeñas. Proporciona ISR día/noche, entrega precisa de pequeñas cargas de pago y compromiso cinético de los UAV hostiles. A pesar de su pequeño tamaño, AXQ ofrece un rango significativo y capacidad de carga útil, convirtiéndolo en una herramienta flexible para la infantería, fuerzas especiales y unidades de seguridad
fields.description_fr: AXQ est un quadcopter tactique compact conçu comme un atout consommable pour le soutien direct des petites unités. Il fournit jour/nuit ISR, la livraison de précision de petites charges utiles et l'engagement cinétique des UAV hostiles. Malgré sa petite taille, AXQ offre une portée et une capacité de charge utile significatives, ce qui en fait un outil flexible pour l'infanterie, les forces spéciales et les unités de sécurité
fields.description_it: AXQ è un quadcopter tattico compatto progettato come risorsa di consumo per il supporto diretto di piccole unità. Fornisce giorno / notte ISR, consegna di precisione di piccoli carichi di pagamento e impegno cinetico di UAV ostili. Nonostante le sue dimensioni ridotte, AXQ offre una gamma significativa e capacità di carico utile, rendendolo uno strumento flessibile per la fanteria, forze speciali e unità di sicurezza

fields.description_en: The AI-DEF Ground Control Station is a tactical C2 node for UAVs, UGVs and counter-UAV sensors. A single station can control multiple unmanned platforms simultaneously while providing a fused operational picture.

fields.description_es: La estación de control terrestre AI-DEF es un nodo C2 táctico para sensores UAV, UGV y contra-UAV. Una sola estación puede controlar múltiples plataformas no tripuladas simultáneamente, proporcionando un cuadro operativo fusionado.

fields.name: AX2NG-KRAKATIT
fields.description: AX2NG KRAKATIT is a jet-powered loitering munition designed for high-value targets and counter-UAV missions. With top speeds up to approximately 430 km/h, it is engineered for rapid penetration of air-defence zones and operation in intense electronic warfare environments. The platform carries up to 4 kg of configurable HE/HEF warhead, optimised to defeat lightly armoured vehicles, radars, air-defence assets and reconnaissance systems.
fields.description_en: AX2NG KRAKATIT is a jet-powered loitering munition designed for high-value targets and counter-UAV missions. With top speeds up to approximately 430 km/h, it is engineered for rapid penetration of air-defence zones and operation in intense electronic warfare environments. The platform carries up to 4 kg of configurable HE/HEF warhead, optimised to defeat lightly armoured vehicles, radars, air-defence assets and reconnaissance systems.
fields.description_de: AX2NG KRAKATIT ist eine strahlgetriebene Herumlungermunition, die für hochwertige Ziele und Anti-UAV-Missionen entwickelt wurde. Mit Höchstgeschwindigkeiten von bis zu etwa 430 km/h ist es für das schnelle Eindringen in Luftverteidigungszonen und den Einsatz in Umgebungen intensiver elektronischer Kriegsführung ausgelegt. Die Plattform trägt bis zu 4 kg konfigurierbaren HE/HEF-Sprengkopf, der für die Bekämpfung leicht gepanzerter Fahrzeuge, Radargeräte, Luftverteidigungsanlagen und Aufklärungssysteme optimiert ist.
fields.description_sk: AX2NG KRAKATIT je prúdová munícia navrhnutá pre vysokohodnotné ciele a protiUAV misie. S maximálnymi rýchlosťami až do približne 430 km/h je navrhnutý na rýchle prenikanie do zón protivzdušnej obrany a prevádzku v prostredí intenzívneho elektronického boja. Platforma nesie až 4 kg konfigurovateľnej hlavice HE/HEF, optimalizovanej na porazenie ľahko obrnených vozidiel, radarov, prostriedkov protivzdušnej obrany a prieskumných systémov.
fields.description_es: AX2NG KRAKATIT es una munición de alto valor diseñada para objetivos de alto valor y misiones contra los VA. Con velocidades superiores de hasta aproximadamente 430 km/h, está diseñado para la penetración rápida de las zonas de defensa del aire y la operación en ambientes de guerra electrónica intensos. La plataforma lleva hasta 4 kg de ojivas configurables HE/HEF, optimizadas para derrotar vehículos, radares, activos de defensa aérea y sistemas de reconocimiento.
fields.description_fr: AX2NG KRAKATIT est une munition à réaction conçue pour des cibles de grande valeur et des missions anti-UAV. Avec des vitesses supérieures jusqu'à environ 430 km/h, il est conçu pour une pénétration rapide des zones de défense aérienne et des opérations dans des environnements de guerre électronique intenses. La plate-forme transporte jusqu'à 4 kg d'ogive configurable HE/HEF, optimisée pour vaincre les véhicules blindés légers, les radars, les moyens de défense aérienne et les systèmes de reconnaissance.
fields.description_it: AX2NG KRAKATIT è una munizioni a getto progettato per obiettivi di alto valore e missioni contro-UAV. Con velocità superiore fino a circa 430 km/h, è progettato per una rapida penetrazione delle zone di difesa dell'aria e il funzionamento in ambienti di guerra elettronici intensi. La piattaforma trasporta fino a 4 kg di testata configurabile HE/HEF, ottimizzata per sconfiggere veicoli blindati, radar, asset di difesa aerea e sistemi di ricognizione.

The platform combines vertical take-off and landing capability with efficient fixed-wing flight, allowing deployment without runway infrastructure and operation from confined or improvised locations.

The system supports security, defence, infrastructure protection and search-and-rescue operations where persistent aerial monitoring and rapid deployment are required.

fields.name: Anti-UAV and Special Missions
fields.description: AXQ supports counter-UAV missions requiring agility and close-range engagement. It can intercept, collide with, or disrupt hostile small UAVs, and can also be configured for precise payload delivery in urban or complex terrain

fields.description_de: AXQ unterstützt Anti-UAV-Missionen, die Agilität und Nahkampf erfordern. Es kann feindliche kleine UAVs abfangen, mit ihnen kollidieren oder sie stören und kann auch für die präzise Lieferung von Nutzlasten in städtischem oder komplexem Gelände konfiguriert werden
fields.description_sk: AXQ podporuje misie proti UAV vyžadujúce svižnosť a zapojenie na blízko. Môže zachytiť, zraziť alebo narušiť nepriateľské malé UAV a môže byť tiež nakonfigurovaný na presné doručovanie užitočného zaťaženia v mestskom alebo zložitom teréne.
fields.description_es: AXQ apoya las misiones contra los VA que requieren agilidad y compromiso de cerca. Puede interceptar, collide con o interrumpir pequeños UAV hostiles, y también puede configurarse para una entrega precisa de carga útil en terrenos urbanos o complejos
fields.description_fr: AXQ prend en charge les missions anti-UAV nécessitant agilité et engagement à proximité. Il peut intercepter, entrer en collision avec de petits UAV hostiles ou les perturber, et peut également être configuré pour une livraison précise de la charge utile en milieu urbain ou complexe
fields.description_it: AXQ supporta missioni contro-UAV che richiedono agilità e impegno a distanza ravvicinata. Può intercettare, scontrarsi con, o interrompere piccoli UAV ostili, e può anche essere configurato per una consegna precisa del carico utile in terreno urbano o complesso

fields.name: Integration with UGV 150-DUP and GCS

fields.title: Engineering Advanced AI & Autonomous Systems
fields.subtitle:
At AI DEF, our mission is to push the boundaries of what artificial intelligence and automation can achieve.
We develop next-generation technologies and integrate them into:
aviation and UAV systems
UGV platforms
security and defense solutions
Our focus areas include autonomy, mission control, multi-domain integration, situational awareness and intelligent decision support.
We build systems that make operations smarter, safer and more effective.
Turning engineering challenges into real-world capabilities.

fields.title: AV2-220 VTOL ISR
paragraphs: What We Are Offering
The system is capable of vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) – it does not need a runway and can operate from small prepared or improvised sites.
We are offering a complete unmanned aerial system (UAS) AV2-220 VTOL ISR designed for:
bullets: long-endurance aerial surveillance and monitoring,
protection of facilities and infrastructure,
support to security, defence and rescue organizations.

fields.title: The delivery includes:
paragraphs: ㅤ
bullets: the unmanned aircraft AV2-220 VTOL ISR,
an EO/IR reconnaissance sensor pod (day and thermal camera + laser rangefinder),
a ground control station (GCS) for the pilot and sensor operator,
a basic accessory package, training and technical support.

fields.title: AV2-220 VTOL ISR Unmanned Aircraft
paragraphs: Airframe and Shape
Type: fixed-wing unmanned aircraft, biplane configuration (two wings above each other)
bullets: Wingspan: 2.2 m.
Structure material: composite (lightweight, strong, weather-resistant).
Take-off and landing: VTOL – vertical take-off and vertical landing, no runway required.
VTOL motors:
Number: 8 vertical electric motors.
Function: provide vertical lift during take-off, landing and transition phases.

fields.title: Propulsion System
paragraphs: The aircraft uses a hybrid propulsion system:
bullets: A combustion engine drives the main propeller in horizontal flight and generates electrical power.
A generator + batteries supply electrical power to:
the 8 vertical lift motors during take-off and landing,
onboard systems and the sensor payload.

fields.title: Target Performance Parameters
paragraphs: (The values below are target design values that guide detailed engineering and flight testing.)
bullets: Payload capacity: at least 5 kg (sensor pod + reserve).
Maximum speed: at least 100 km/h.
Cruise speed: approximately 70 km/h.
Range: approximately 1000 km (typical ISR mission profile).
Endurance: approximately 12 hours of continuous flight.
Operating ceiling: at least 5000 ft (~1500 m) above ground.
Wind resistance: up to Beaufort F7
(strong wind, suitable for realistic field operations).

fields.title: Navigation and Flight Control
paragraphs: The system is designed to fly fully automatically, while allowing operator intervention at any time.

fields.title: Automatic Control
paragraphs: An onboard flight control computer (autopilot) processes data from:
bullets: satellite navigation (GPS/GNSS),
inertial sensors (attitude, heading, accelerations),
air data (altitude and airspeed).
Supported modes include:
fully automatic VTOL take-off and transition to horizontal flight,
flight along a pre-planned route using waypoints,
automatic return-to-home,
automatic loiter / orbit over an area of interest,
fully automatic VTOL landing.

fields.title: Manual Operator Intervention
paragraphs: The operator can take over at any time to:
bullets: select a different flight mode,
change altitude, speed or direction,
interrupt the mission and command the aircraft to return to base.

fields.title: EO/IR Reconnaissance Sensor Pod
paragraphs: The aircraft is equipped with a stabilized sensor pod (gimbal) with the following characteristics:

fields.title: Basic Technical Data
bullets: Weight: < 5 kg.
Power supply: 24 V DC, max. 100 W.
Mounting: stabilized gimbal (ensures smooth imagery while the aircraft is moving).
Stabilization accuracy: approx. 80 mrad.
Mechanical range:
Azimuth: 360° (full rotation),
Pitch: from +20° above the horizon down to −110° below the horizon.

fields.title: Optical Sensors
paragraphs: Day (electro-optical) camera:
bullets: Field of view: from wide 61° down to narrow 2.2°.
Optical zoom: minimum 30×.
Thermal (IR) camera:
Field of view: from 28° down to 9.4°.
Optical zoom: minimum 3×.
Laser module:
Type: eye-safe laser.
Range: up to 6 km.
Accuracy: approximately ± 1 m under nominal conditions.

fields.title: Detection / Identification Ranges (Nominal)
paragraphs: Day camera:
(Actual ranges depend on target size, environment and weather conditions.)
bullets: detection of targets up to approx. 10 km,
identification of targets up to approx. 5 km.
Thermal camera:
detection up to approx. 5 km,
identification up to approx. 3 km.

fields.title: Functions
bullets: Day–thermal image blending for better readability of the scene.
Automatic target tracking (auto-track) – the system keeps a designated object centered in the image.
BITE – built-in test equipment that checks sensor functionality at start-up and during operation.

fields.title: Ground Control Station (GCS)
paragraphs: Role and Equipment
We provide a ground control station that enables:
bullets: aircraft control by the pilot,
sensor operation by the payload operator,
mission planning and real-time monitoring.
Standard equipment:
pilot workstation (aircraft control, telemetry monitoring),
sensor operator workstation (EO/IR pod control, video exploitation),
displays with map background and live aircraft track,
visualization of battery, fuel, engine and link status,
video and telemetry recording for archiving and post-mission analysis.

fields.title: Communications
bullets: Data radio link between the aircraft and GCS (command and telemetry).
Video downlink from the cameras in real time.
Encryption and authentication according to the client’s requirements and applicable regulations.

fields.title: Scope of Supply and Services
paragraphs: The exact scope (number of units) is tailored to the client’s needs. A typical system package includes:
bullets: AV2-220 VTOL ISR unmanned aircraft (e.g. 2–4 units),
associated EO/IR sensor pods (1 per aircraft),
at least one complete ground control station,
initial set of spare parts and consumables,
charging and technical support equipment.

fields.title: Training
paragraphs: Pilot and operator training (GCS operation and sensor employment), technical training (maintenance, pre-flight and post-flight checks, module replacement).

fields.title: Commissioning and Initial Operations
paragraphs: Support during first deployments in the client’s environment, assistance with setting operating procedures and documentation.

fields.title: Service and Support
paragraphs: Warranty service, optional post-warranty service contracts (periodic inspections, repairs, software updates).

fields.title: Commercial Terms
paragraphs: The system price will be defined based on:
bullets: the number of aircraft,
the number of sensor pods,
the number and type of ground control stations,
the scope of training and support.
Delivery times, payment terms and contractual details will be specified in a formal commercial offer once the required quantities and configuration are confirmed.

fields.title: Unamanned Aerial System
fields.description:
• AX2NG Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) is a jet-powered kamikaze drone, controlled by artificial intelligence, manual or semi-automatic methods. This drone is equipped with infrared camera, RGB camera, LIDAR, and frequency and signal direction scanning technology to effectively identify targets.

• The UAS has a command, control, and communication (C3) system for operational awareness, information exchange, and data transmission. This system can be either AI AUTONOMUS or semi-automatically operated and incorporates the ability to perform under autonomous conditions as well.

• The drone is capable of carrying a 4 kg warhead and provides modes of operation such as takeoff, route, circle, re-entry, maintaining specific flight parameters, flight to a point, and special modes. It has the ability to navigate towards a target using AI-based guidance systems, solving navigation issues to ensure the implementation of these modes.

Optimized for EW-intensive and peer-to-peer conflict environments:
AX2 is built for high-threat environments with capable adversaries (e.g. with radar, EW, and air defenses).

Superior EW resilience:
GNSS-independent navigation, LIDAR, Angle-of-Attack sensors, Jetson onboard AI, Starlink + LTE fallback, RS-422 hardened communication.

Safe-Arm Control Block ensures secure arming and detonation logic under verified parameters.

Strike effectiveness and penetration:
Jet engine propulsion and top speed of 430 km/h allow the AX2 to penetrate air defense envelopes rapidly.
Configurable HE and HEF warheads with tailored blast and fragmentation profiles against light armor or fixed targets.

Production sovereignty and logistical control:
Fully localizable production: AI-DEF offers the option for licensed manufacturing with full documentation.
No reliance on external suppliers = secure wartime supply chain.

C2 system and AI integration:
AI-DEF Ground Control System is modular, autonomous, and compatible with military C2 environments.
Supports swarm operations, autonomous target selection, AI-enhanced decision-making, and human-in-the-loop override.

Diese Drohne ist mit einer Infrarotkamera, einer RGB-Kamera, LIDAR sowie Frequenz- und Signalrichtungsscantechnologie ausgestattet, um Ziele effektiv zu identifizieren.

• Das UAS verfügt über ein Befehls-, Kontroll- und Kommunikationssystem (C3) zur betrieblichen Aufklärung, zum Informationsaustausch und zur Datenübertragung. Dieses System kann entweder AI AUTONOMUS oder halbautomatisch betrieben werden und bietet auch die Möglichkeit, unter autonomen Bedingungen zu arbeiten.

• Die Drohne kann einen 4-kg-Sprengkopf tragen und bietet Betriebsmodi wie Start, Route, Kreis, Wiedereintritt, Beibehaltung spezifischer Flugparameter, Flug zu einem Punkt und spezielle Modi. Es ist in der Lage, mithilfe von KI-basierten Leitsystemen zu einem Ziel zu navigieren und Navigationsprobleme zu lösen, um die Umsetzung dieser Modi sicherzustellen.

Optimiert für EW-intensive und Peer-to-Peer-Konfliktumgebungen:
AX2 ist für Umgebungen mit hoher Bedrohung und fähigen Gegnern konzipiert (z. B. mit Radar, EW und Luftverteidigung).

Überlegene EW-Belastbarkeit:
GNSS-unabhängige Navigation, LIDAR, Anstellwinkelsensoren, integrierte KI von Jetson, Starlink + LTE-Fallback, sichere RS-422-Kommunikation.

Der Safe-Arm-Kontrollblock gewährleistet eine sichere Scharfschalt- und Detonationslogik unter verifizierten Parametern.

Schlagwirksamkeit und Durchschlagskraft:
Der Antrieb durch ein Strahltriebwerk und eine Höchstgeschwindigkeit von 430 km/h ermöglichen es der AX2, Luftverteidigungsbereiche schnell zu durchdringen.
Konfigurierbare HE- und HEF-Sprengköpfe mit maßgeschneiderten Explosions- und Fragmentierungsprofilen gegen leichte Panzerung oder feste Ziele.

Produktionshoheit und logistische Kontrolle:
Vollständig lokalisierbare Produktion: AI-DEF bietet die Möglichkeit einer lizenzierten Fertigung mit vollständiger Dokumentation.
Keine Abhängigkeit von externen Lieferanten = sichere Lieferkette während des Krieges.

C2-System und KI-Integration:
Das AI-DEF-Bodenkontrollsystem ist modular, autonom und mit militärischen C2-Umgebungen kompatibel.
Unterstützt Schwarmoperationen, autonome Zielauswahl, KI-gestützte Entscheidungsfindung und Human-in-the-Loop-Override.
fields.description_sk:

Tento dron je vybavený infračervenou kamerou, RGB kamerou, LIDARom a technológiou frekvenčného a smerového skenovania signálu na efektívnu identifikáciu cieľov.

• UAS má systém velenia, riadenia a komunikácie (C3) na operačnú informovanosť, výmenu informácií a prenos údajov. Tento systém môže byť ovládaný buď AI AUTONOMUS alebo poloautomaticky a zahŕňa schopnosť pracovať aj v autonómnych podmienkach.

• Dron je schopný niesť 4 kg hlavicu a poskytuje prevádzkové režimy ako vzlet, trasa, kruh, opätovný vstup, udržiavanie špecifických parametrov letu, let do bodu a špeciálne režimy. Má schopnosť navigovať k cieľu pomocou navádzacích systémov založených na AI, čím rieši problémy s navigáciou, aby sa zabezpečila implementácia týchto režimov.

Optimalizované pre prostredia náročné na EW a konflikty typu peer-to-peer:
AX2 je skonštruovaný pre vysoko ohrozené prostredia so schopnými protivníkmi (napr. s radarom, EW a protivzdušnou obranou).

Špičková EW odolnosť:
Navigácia nezávislá od GNSS, LIDAR, senzory uhla nábehu, palubná umelá inteligencia Jetson, núdzový režim Starlink + LTE, spevnená komunikácia RS-422.

Ovládací blok Safe-Arm zaisťuje bezpečné zapnutie a logiku detonácie pri overených parametroch.

Účinnosť úderu a prienik:
Pohon prúdovým motorom a maximálna rýchlosť 430 km/h umožňuje AX2 rýchlo preniknúť do obalov protivzdušnej obrany.
Konfigurovateľné hlavice HE a HEF s prispôsobenými profilmi výbuchu a fragmentácie proti ľahkému pancierovaniu alebo pevným cieľom.

Výrobná suverenita a logistická kontrola:
Plne lokalizovateľná výroba: AI-DEF ponúka možnosť licencovanej výroby s úplnou dokumentáciou.
Žiadne spoliehanie sa na externých dodávateľov = bezpečný vojnový dodávateľský reťazec.

Integrácia systému C2 a AI:
AI-DEF Ground Control System je modulárny, autonómny a kompatibilný s vojenskými prostrediami C2.
Podporuje rojové operácie, autonómny výber cieľov, rozhodovanie vylepšené AI a prepisovanie človekom v slučke.

fields.title: Description
fields.description:
The UGV-150 Frog represents the pinnacle in the realm of small, lightweight, remotely operated robotic vehicles, now enhanced with the capability for autonomous driving thanks to advanced AI.

• This innovative vehicle combines high-tech carbon composite material for its central hull with an intelligent 4x4 all-wheel-drive configuration, ensuring unmatched agility and durability.

• Equipped with artificial intelligence capable of autonomous navigation and target identification, the UGV-150 Frog is the ideal solution for a broad range of applications from civilian to defense purposes
fields.description_en:
The UGV-150 Frog represents the pinnacle in the realm of small, lightweight, remotely operated robotic vehicles, now enhanced with the capability for autonomous driving thanks to advanced AI.

• This innovative vehicle combines high-tech carbon composite material for its central hull with an intelligent 4x4 all-wheel-drive configuration, ensuring unmatched agility and durability.

• Equipped with artificial intelligence capable of autonomous navigation and target identification, the UGV-150 Frog is the ideal solution for a broad range of applications from civilian to defense purposes
fields.description_de:
Der UGV-150 Frog stellt den Höhepunkt im Bereich kleiner, leichter, ferngesteuerter Roboterfahrzeuge dar, die dank fortschrittlicher KI jetzt um die Fähigkeit zum autonomen Fahren erweitert wurden.

• Dieses innovative Fahrzeug kombiniert High-Tech-Carbon-Verbundmaterial für seinen zentralen Rumpf mit einer intelligenten 4x4-Allradantriebskonfiguration und sorgt so für unübertroffene Agilität und Haltbarkeit.

• Ausgestattet mit künstlicher Intelligenz, die eine autonome Navigation und Zielidentifizierung ermöglicht, ist der UGV-150 Frog die ideale Lösung für ein breites Anwendungsspektrum von zivilen bis hin zu Verteidigungszwecken
fields.description_sk:
UGV-150 Frog predstavuje vrchol v oblasti malých, ľahkých, diaľkovo ovládaných robotických vozidiel, teraz vylepšených o schopnosť autonómneho riadenia vďaka pokročilej AI.

• Toto inovatívne vozidlo kombinuje high-tech uhlíkový kompozitný materiál pre svoj centrálny trup s inteligentnou konfiguráciou pohonu všetkých kolies 4x4, ktorá zaisťuje bezkonkurenčnú obratnosť a odolnosť.

• UGV-150 Frog vybavený umelou inteligenciou schopnou autonómnej navigácie a identifikácie cieľa je ideálnym riešením pre širokú škálu aplikácií od civilných až po obranné účely.
fields.description_es:
La Rana UGV-150 representa el pináculo en el reino de los vehículos robóticos pequeños, ligeros y operados remotamente, ahora mejorado con la capacidad de conducción autónoma gracias a la IA avanzada.

• Este innovador vehículo combina material compuesto de carbono de alta tecnología para su casco central con una configuración inteligente 4x4 de todo el volante, garantizando una agilidad y durabilidad incomparables.

• Equipada con inteligencia artificial capaz de navegación autónoma e identificación de objetivos, la Rana UGV-150 es la solución ideal para una amplia gama de aplicaciones de uso civil a defensa
fields.description_fr:
L'UGV-150 Frog représente le pinacle dans le domaine des petits véhicules robotiques légers et télécommandés, désormais renforcés par la capacité de conduite autonome grâce à l'IA avancée.

• Ce véhicule innovant combine des matériaux composites carbone de haute technologie pour sa coque centrale avec une configuration 4x4 intelligente, assurant une agilité et une durabilité inégalées.

• Équipé d'intelligence artificielle capable de navigation autonome et d'identification des cibles, la grenouille UGV-150 est la solution idéale pour un large éventail d'applications, du civil à la défense
fields.description_it:
La rana UGV-150 rappresenta il pinnacolo nel regno dei piccoli veicoli robotici leggeri e a distanza, ora potenziati con la capacità di guida autonoma grazie all'intelligenza artificiale avanzata.

• Questo innovativo veicolo combina materiali compositi in carbonio ad alta tecnologia per il suo scafo centrale con una configurazione intelligente 4x4 a ruote, garantendo agilità e durata senza pari.

• Dotato di intelligenza artificiale in grado di navigare autonoma e di identificare l'obiettivo, UGV-150 Frog è la soluzione ideale per una vasta gamma di applicazioni da civili a scopi di difesa

fields.title: Intelligent Navigation
fields.text: The integration of artificial intelligence and advanced sensors enables the AX2NG system to autonomously identify, classify, and track targets with high precision and adaptability. It supports autonomous guidance even under GNSS-denied conditions by leveraging AI-assisted sensor fusion from AHRS, magnetometer, differential LIDAR, and optical flow systems. Additionally, the system is capable of autonomous object cataloging and supports coordinated swarm control of multiple UAVs..
fields.text_en: The integration of artificial intelligence and advanced sensors enables the AX2NG system to autonomously identify, classify, and track targets with high precision and adaptability. It supports autonomous guidance even under GNSS-denied conditions by leveraging AI-assisted sensor fusion from AHRS, magnetometer, differential LIDAR, and optical flow systems. Additionally, the system is capable of autonomous object cataloging and supports coordinated swarm control of multiple UAVs..
fields.text_de: Die Integration von künstlicher Intelligenz und fortschrittlichen Sensoren ermöglicht es dem AX2NG-System, Ziele autonom mit hoher Präzision und Anpassungsfähigkeit zu identifizieren, zu klassifizieren und zu verfolgen. Es unterstützt die autonome Führung auch unter GNSS-verweigerten Bedingungen durch die Nutzung der KI-gestützten Sensorfusion von AHRS, Magnetometer, Differential-LIDAR und optischen Flusssystemen. Darüber hinaus ist das System in der Lage, autonome Objekte zu katalogisieren und unterstützt die koordinierte Schwarmsteuerung mehrerer UAVs.
fields.text_sk: Integrácia umelej inteligencie a pokročilých senzorov umožňuje systému AX2NG autonómne identifikovať, klasifikovať a sledovať ciele s vysokou presnosťou a prispôsobivosťou. Podporuje autonómne navádzanie aj v podmienkach odmietnutia GNSS využívaním fúzie senzorov za pomoci AI z AHRS, magnetometra, diferenciálneho LIDARu a optických prietokových systémov. Okrem toho je systém schopný autonómnej katalogizácie objektov a podporuje koordinované riadenie roja viacerých UAV.
fields.text_es: La integración de la inteligencia artificial y los sensores avanzados permite al sistema AX2NG identificar, clasificar y rastrear de forma autónoma objetivos con alta precisión y adaptabilidad. Soporta orientación autónoma incluso bajo condiciones de GNSS mediante la fusión de sensores asistidos por IA de AHRS, magnetómetro, LIDAR diferencial y sistemas de flujo óptico. Además, el sistema es capaz de catalogar objetos autónomos y es compatible con el control coordinado de múltiples UAVs..
fields.text_fr: L'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle et des capteurs avancés permet au système AX2NG d'identifier, de classer et de suivre de manière autonome des cibles avec une grande précision et une grande adaptabilité. Il prend en charge le guidage autonome même dans des conditions refusées par GNSS en tirant parti de la fusion de capteurs assistés par l'IA à partir d'AHRS, de magnétomètre, de LIDAR différentiel et de systèmes d'écoulement optique. De plus, le système est capable de catalogage autonome d'objets et prend en charge le contrôle coordonné de plusieurs UAV.
fields.text_it: L'integrazione di intelligenza artificiale e sensori avanzati consente al sistema AX2NG di identificare autonomamente, classificare e tracciare obiettivi con alta precisione e adattabilità. Supporta la guida autonoma anche in condizioni GNSS-denied sfruttando la fusione del sensore AI-assisted da AHRS, magnetometro, LIDAR differenziale e sistemi di flusso ottico. Inoltre, il sistema è in grado di catalogazione degli oggetti autonomi e supporta il controllo coordinato dello sciame di più UAV..

fields.title: Multipurpose Assault
fields.text: The AX2NG is capable of attacking high-value ground targets as well as aerial targets, including UAVs flying up to 300 km/h and helicopters. This makes the AX2NG a versatile military platform.
fields.text_en: The AX2NG is capable of attacking high-value ground targets as well as aerial targets, including UAVs flying up to 300 km/h and helicopters. This makes the AX2NG a versatile military platform.
fields.text_de: Der AX2NG ist in der Lage, hochwertige Bodenziele sowie Luftziele anzugreifen, darunter UAVs mit einer Geschwindigkeit von bis zu 300 km/h und Hubschrauber. Dies macht den AX2NG zu einer vielseitigen militärischen Plattform.
fields.text_sk: AX2NG je schopný útočiť na vysokohodnotné pozemné ciele, ako aj na vzdušné ciele, vrátane UAV letiacich do rýchlosti 300 km/h a vrtuľníkov. To robí z AX2NG všestrannú vojenskú platformu.
fields.text_es: El AX2NG es capaz de atacar objetivos terrestres de alto valor, así como objetivos aéreos, incluidos los UAV que vuelan hasta 300 km/h y helicópteros. Esto hace que el AX2NG sea una plataforma militar versátil.
fields.text_fr: L'AX2NG est capable d'attaquer des cibles terrestres de grande valeur ainsi que des cibles aériennes, y compris des UAV volant jusqu'à 300 km/h et des hélicoptères. Cela fait de l'AX2NG une plateforme militaire polyvalente.
fields.text_it: L'AX2NG è in grado di attaccare obiettivi di terra di alto valore e obiettivi aerei, tra cui UAV che volano fino a 300 km/h ed elicotteri. Questo rende AX2NG una piattaforma militare versatile.

fields.title: Jet-Powered Speed
fields.text: The jet propulsion engine provides high speed and agility, enabling the AX2NG to effectively respond to dynamic combat situations and reach its targets rapidly.
fields.text_en: The jet propulsion engine provides high speed and agility, enabling the AX2NG to effectively respond to dynamic combat situations and reach its targets rapidly.
fields.text_de: Der Strahlantrieb sorgt für hohe Geschwindigkeit und Agilität und ermöglicht es dem AX2NG, effektiv auf dynamische Kampfsituationen zu reagieren und seine Ziele schnell zu erreichen.
fields.text_sk: Prúdový motor poskytuje vysokú rýchlosť a obratnosť, čo umožňuje AX2NG efektívne reagovať na dynamické bojové situácie a rýchlo dosiahnuť svoje ciele.
fields.text_es: El motor de propulsión de chorro proporciona alta velocidad y agilidad, lo que permite al AX2NG responder eficazmente a situaciones de combate dinámicas y alcanzar sus objetivos rápidamente.
fields.text_fr: Le moteur de propulsion à réaction offre une vitesse et une agilité élevées, permettant à l'AX2NG de réagir efficacement aux situations de combat dynamiques et d'atteindre rapidement ses objectifs.
fields.text_it: Il motore di propulsione a getto fornisce alta velocità e agilità, consentendo all'AX2NG di rispondere efficacemente alle situazioni di combattimento dinamiche e raggiungere rapidamente i suoi obiettivi.

• Poskytovanie režimov: vzlet, trasa, kruh, opätovný vstup, udržiavanie špecifikovaných parametrov letu, let do bodu, špeciálne režimy.
• Riešenie problémov s navigáciou na zabezpečenie implementácie režimov.
• Výmena dát medzi UAV.
• Výmena informácií s pozemnou riadiacou stanicou (GCS).
• Zaznamenávanie údajov z palubných systémov a senzorov.
• Vytváranie a odosielanie telemetrie z UAV.
• Príjem, spracovanie a vykonávanie príkazov a pridelených letových programov z GCS.
• Autonómne monitorovanie stavu systémov.
• Rekonfigurácia v prípade poruchy zariadenia lietadla.
• Počítanie súradníc v prípade straty signálov z GNSS metódou smerovania a použitím optického kanála riadeného AI.
• Vyhľadajte cieľ podľa predtým známych charakteristík vo viditeľnom rozsahu v danej oblasti.
fields.text_es:
• Proporcionar control autónomo, automático, semiautomático y manual.
• Suministro de modos: despegue, ruta, círculo, reingreso, mantenimiento de los parámetros de vuelo especificados, vuelo a un punto, modos especiales.
• Solución de problemas de navegación para garantizar la implementación de los modos.
• Intercambio de datos entre UAVs.
• Intercambio de información con la estación de control terrestre (GCS).
• Registro de datos de sistemas a bordo y sensores.
• Formación y envío de telemetría desde UAV.
• Recepción, procesamiento y ejecución de comandos y programas de vuelo asignados del GCS.
• Vigilancia autónoma del estado de los sistemas.
• Reconfiguración en caso de fallo del equipo de aeronaves.
• Reckoning of coordinates in the event of loss of signals from the GNSS by the heading method and using the AI controlled óptico channel.
• Busque un objetivo según las características previamente conocidas en el rango visible en un área determinada.
fields.text_fr:
• Fournir un contrôle autonome, automatique, semi-automatique et manuel.
• Mise à disposition de modes : décollage, route, cercle, rentrée, maintien des paramètres de vol spécifiés, vol vers un point, modes spéciaux.
• Résoudre les problèmes de navigation pour assurer la mise en œuvre des modes.
• Échange de données entre UAV.
• Échange d'informations avec la station de contrôle au sol (GCS).
• Enregistrement des données des systèmes et capteurs embarqués.
• Formation et envoi de télémétrie de l'UAV.
• Réception, traitement et exécution des commandes et des programmes de vol assignés par le GCS.
• Contrôle autonome de l'état des systèmes.
• Reconfiguration en cas de panne d'équipement d'aéronef.
• Reckonnage des coordonnées en cas de perte de signaux du GNSS par la méthode de cap et en utilisant le canal optique contrôlé par l'IA.
• Recherche d'une cible selon des caractéristiques connues dans la plage visible dans une zone donnée.
fields.text_it:
• Fornire il controllo automatico, automatico, semiautomatico e manuale dell'AI.
• Disposizione delle modalità: decollo, percorso, cerchio, rientro, mantenimento dei parametri di volo specificati, volo a un punto, modalità speciali.
• Risolvere i problemi di navigazione per garantire l'attuazione delle modalità.
• Scambio di dati tra gli UAV.
• Scambio di informazioni con la centrale di controllo (GCS).
• Registrazione dei dati da sistemi e sensori di bordo.
• Formazione e trasmissione di telemetria da UAV.
• Ricevimento, elaborazione ed esecuzione dei comandi e programmi di volo assegnati dal GCS.
• Monitoraggio autonomo dello stato dei sistemi.
• Riconfigurazione in caso di guasto dell'equipaggiamento aereo.
• Conto di coordinate in caso di perdita di segnali dal GNSS tramite il metodo di intestazione e utilizzando il canale ottico controllato AI.
• Cercare un bersaglio in base alle caratteristiche precedentemente note nella gamma visibile in una determinata area.

fields.title: AI-Def Pilot
fields.text:
A comprehensive and user-friendly software for managing UAS, offering deep integration with various drone types and robotic vehicles.

Features include universal compatibility, intuitive mission planning tools, real-time data monitoring, and advanced safety features.
fields.text_en:
A comprehensive and user-friendly software for managing UAS, offering deep integration with various drone types and robotic vehicles.

Features include universal compatibility, intuitive mission planning tools, real-time data monitoring, and advanced safety features.
fields.text_de:
Eine umfassende und benutzerfreundliche Software zur Verwaltung von UAS, die eine tiefe Integration mit verschiedenen Drohnentypen und Roboterfahrzeugen bietet.

Zu den Funktionen gehören universelle Kompatibilität, intuitive Missionsplanungstools, Echtzeit-Datenüberwachung und erweiterte Sicherheitsfunktionen.
fields.text_sk:
Komplexný a užívateľsky prívetivý softvér na správu UAS, ktorý ponúka hĺbkovú integráciu s rôznymi typmi dronov a robotických vozidiel.

Medzi funkcie patrí univerzálna kompatibilita, intuitívne nástroje na plánovanie misií, monitorovanie údajov v reálnom čase a pokročilé bezpečnostné funkcie.
fields.text_es:
Un software completo y fácil de usar para gestionar UAS, que ofrece una profunda integración con varios tipos de drones y vehículos robóticos.

Las características incluyen compatibilidad universal, herramientas intuitivas de planificación de misiones, monitoreo de datos en tiempo real y funciones avanzadas de seguridad.
fields.text_fr:
Un logiciel complet et convivial pour gérer l'UAS, offrant une intégration profonde avec différents types de drones et de véhicules robotiques.

Les caractéristiques comprennent la compatibilité universelle, des outils de planification de mission intuitifs, la surveillance des données en temps réel et des fonctions de sécurité avancées.
fields.text_it:
Un software completo e facile da usare per gestire UAS, che offre una profonda integrazione con vari tipi di droni e veicoli robotici.

Le funzionalità includono compatibilità universale, strumenti di pianificazione delle missioni intuitivi, monitoraggio dei dati in tempo reale e funzionalità di sicurezza avanzate.

fields.title: AI-Def Targeting
fields.text:
Builds upon the foundation of AI-Def Pilot, extending its functionality with specialized capabilities for advanced tracking and processing of UAV video streams.

Offers dual-resolution video streaming, RGB and thermal imaging, zoomable video streams, and automatic display of detected targets on a digital map.
fields.text_en:
Builds upon the foundation of AI-Def Pilot, extending its functionality with specialized capabilities for advanced tracking and processing of UAV video streams.

Offers dual-resolution video streaming, RGB and thermal imaging, zoomable video streams, and automatic display of detected targets on a digital map.
fields.text_de:
Baut auf der Grundlage von AI-Def Pilot auf und erweitert seine Funktionalität um spezielle Funktionen für die erweiterte Verfolgung und Verarbeitung von UAV-Videostreams.

Bietet Videostreaming mit doppelter Auflösung, RGB- und Wärmebilder, zoombare Videostreams und automatische Anzeige erkannter Ziele auf einer digitalen Karte.
fields.text_sk:
Vychádza zo základov AI-Def Pilot a rozširuje jeho funkčnosť o špecializované schopnosti pre pokročilé sledovanie a spracovanie video streamov UAV.

Ponúka streamovanie videa s dvojitým rozlíšením, RGB a termovíziu, zoomovateľné video streamy a automatické zobrazenie zistených cieľov na digitálnej mape.
fields.text_es:
Construye sobre la base de AI-Def Pilot, ampliando su funcionalidad con capacidades especializadas para el seguimiento avanzado y procesamiento de secuencias de vídeo UAV.

Ofrece streaming de vídeo de doble resolución, RGB e imágenes térmicas, secuencias de vídeo zoom y visualización automática de objetivos detectados en un mapa digital.
fields.text_fr:
S'appuie sur la base du pilote AI-Def, en élargissant sa fonctionnalité avec des capacités spécialisées pour le suivi et le traitement avancés des flux vidéo UAV.

Offre du streaming vidéo à double résolution, RGB et l'imagerie thermique, des flux vidéo zoomables, et l'affichage automatique des cibles détectées sur une carte numérique.
fields.text_it:
Si basa sulla fondazione di AI-Def Pilot, estendendo la sua funzionalità con capacità specializzate per il monitoraggio avanzato e l'elaborazione di flussi video UAV.

Offre lo streaming video a doppia risoluzione, RGB e immagini termiche, flussi video zoomabili, e la visualizzazione automatica di obiettivi rilevati su una mappa digitale.
